purpose: Decide whether the residual floor ||R_h(u*)|| decays with grid refinement (a rasterisation artifact) or plateaus (a property of auditing with an operator different from the one that made the data).

metadata.native_metric_caveat: `native` averages over ALL fluid cells, but `diagnose` zeroes a ONE-CELL wall ring whose physical thickness shrinks with h. The averaging set therefore changes between rungs and `native` is NOT resolution-comparable; it is reported only for continuity with the published 128^2 number.
metadata.repaired_caveat: `repaired` adds back div(nu_eff(grad u + grad u^T)) minus nu_eff*lap(u). What remains is a LOWER BOUND on the reference-operator mismatch: AirfRANS is Spalart-Allmaras on finite-volume fluxes on a body-fitted mesh, and the SA source terms, FV flux reconstruction and mesh non-orthogonality are not modelled here.
metadata.decision_rule: DECAY: p>=1.5 and finest/coarsest<=0.30. PLATEAU: |p|<0.5 or finest/coarsest>=0.60. Otherwise PARTIAL. Fitted on trustworthy rungs only (h >= median cloud spacing in the band).
